FAKE: Our playbook for the worker console demo, used with made-up claims only.
note: These are our own working rules, not official ones: the evidence each denial type needs, the words the checker looks for, tone and length limits, and the fee. Melvin reviews them before any real use. Official rules are in appeal-rules.json.
fee_note: Our estimate: a fee of 20% of the amount recovered. The real fee waits for finance/pricing.md and the lawyer (42 CFR 424.73 and 424.80; general information, not legal advice).

letter.why: Our rule: under 120 words a letter rarely explains the denial and the evidence; over 650 words the reviewer at the payer may miss the point.

tone.why: Our rule: appeals are read by clinical and claims reviewers. Calm, factual letters get read; angry ones do not help and can hurt the practice's relationship with the payer.

follow_up.why: Follow up the day after the payer's decision time ends. Mail is counted as taking 5 days to arrive (our estimate).

missing_info.label: Missing information
missing_info.plain: The payer says something was missing, usually a record it asked for.

medical_necessity.label: Medical necessity
medical_necessity.plain: The payer says the service was not needed, or not covered for this diagnosis or this often.

coding.label: Coding
coding.plain: The payer says a code, modifier or diagnosis does not fit the service.

timely_filing.label: Timely filing
timely_filing.plain: The payer says the claim arrived after its filing limit.

authorization.label: Authorization
authorization.plain: The payer says it had no prior authorization for the service.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.plain: The payer thinks the service was billed twice.

eligibility.label: Eligibility
eligibility.plain: The payer says the patient was not covered on the date of service, or could not be found.

plain_by_code.151: More visits than the payer allows
plain_by_code.4: Modifier does not fit the code
plain_by_code.11: Diagnosis does not fit the procedure
plain_by_code.97: Paid as part of another service
plain_by_code.31: Patient not found as a member
plain_by_code.M86: already paid in the time frame
plain_by_code.N115: based on a Local Coverage Determination

visit_note.label: Signed visit note for the date of service
visit_note.short: Signed visit note for the date of service

lmn.label: Letter of medical necessity, signed by the treating doctor
lmn.short: Letter of medical necessity, signed by the treating doctor

prior_treatment.label: Records of earlier treatment (for example physical therapy notes)

auth_approval.label: Prior authorization approval letter
auth_approval.short: Prior authorization approval letter, authorization number {auth}

corrected_claim.label: Corrected claim with the right code

timely_proof.label: Proof of on-time filing (clearinghouse acceptance report)
timely_proof.short: Clearinghouse acceptance report showing the claim was sent on time

eligibility_proof.label: Eligibility check from the date of service
eligibility_proof.short: Eligibility check showing active coverage on the date of service

id_card.label: Member ID card, front and back
id_card.short: Copy of the member ID card

second_note.label: Visit notes for both services (shows they were separate)

denial_notice.label: Copy of the denial notice (remittance or EOB page)

prior_decision.label: Copy of the first appeal decision
prior_decision.short: Copy of the first appeal decision

send_back_reasons: A fact does not match the documents
